brief: Marianne Williams, pioneer missionary to the Māori, was born in 1793. As the wife of Henry Williams she came to New Zealand as a young woman in 1823, and from then on gave her life in unstinting service to the Bay of Islands Māori. As mother of eleven children, nurse, teacher, and friend to anyone in need, she made the love of God widely known. She never saw her homeland again. Instead she sought a better country and “endured as seeing him who is invisible”. She died in 1879.
